note: FAL(Control, Length, Position, Mode, Dest, Expression) writes index 0 and index 4. Secondary documentation puts the destination last; corpus operand-kind profiling falsified that, because index 5 is always the expression and index 4 is always a declared tag. That correction was verified against tools/l5x survey output and had no guard on the adapter. This also covers the expression operand role, which no other fixture exercises: every identifier inside an expression is a read and nothing in an expression is ever written, so Source_A and Source_B are reads even though they sit in a single operand. Ctrl is written and NOT read - a write position suppresses the read, which is what distinguishes a destination from an in-out operand.
